visible_text_lines_in_svg_order: scent arrives first; the heart drifts farther.
why it took so long today.
i'm always so excited to meet you
structure: every visible text line has its own text element with one top-level tspan.
24 explicit data-entrance-group groups: heading, five bubble decorations, three photos with captions, seven glossary pairs, today, scent, remember, anywhere, delicate, uh-uh, farther, credit.
today groups the korean quote, english translation and related anticipation line.
scent has the translucent highlight before the opening quote corner.
sea photo has image, opening caption corner, korean caption, closing corner, english caption.
each two-line aside has opening corner, both korean lines, closing corner, then its english translation lines.
farther groups the final korean quote and both english lines.
photo transforms remain on outer groups; image, captions and white frame are inside photo-float.
backing papers and tapes carry data-photo-for; the sea photo also carries data-note for quoted caption phases.
differences: authored latin copy is lowercase. downloadable original png and all three source photos remain byte-identical.
svg uses native text baselines approximating appkit paragraph layout; browser shaping and fallback glyph metrics may differ by a few pixels.
source paper grain has 36,000 deterministic dots; svg uses a repeating subtle native dot pattern.
photo shadows use fedropshadow instead of appkit nsshadow.
bubbles and glints are native vector paths using the original control points.
no javascript, css animation, reconstructed handwriting paths, candidates, video clips, media tools, or photo manipulation is included.
